preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 1000.
The length of the string s must be an odd number between 1 and 49.
The character c must be a single lowercase letter of the Latin alphabet.

postconditions.description: The output must be either 'YES' or 'NO' for each test case.

postconditions.expression: any(s[i] == c for i in range(0, len(s), 2))
postconditions.description: The output is 'YES' if the character c appears at any even index in the string s.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'NO' if not any(s[i] == c for i in range(0, len(s), 2)) else stdout == 'YES'
postconditions.description: The output is 'NO' if the character c does not appear at any even index in the string s.
